blocks.title: What the construction explains: the hadron structure the Standard Model fits

rows.label: X1
rows.predicate: \textbf{The baryon is three quarks} because the only colourless escape from the gluon residue $0$ is the determinant $\Lambda^N=\det$, which requires exactly $N=3$.

rows.label: X2
rows.predicate: \textbf{The baryon is colour-neutral} as the centre-neutral, triality-$0$ invariant $\varepsilon_{abc}$ of the triality frame, a derived singlet.

rows.label: X3
rows.predicate: \textbf{Baryon number is the Carrier residue $1$}, the determinant winding, so its conservation is the invariance of $\Lambda^3$, on the same footing as the photon residue $2$ and the gluon residue $0$.

rows.label: X4
rows.predicate: \textbf{The Gell-Mann--Okubo relation} is exact, the scale-cancelling identity $2N+2\Xi-3\Lambda-\Sigma=0$ of linear flavour breaking, a derived sum rule.

rows.label: X5
rows.predicate: \textbf{The decuplet is equally spaced} because the strange seed enters the wrap additively.

rows.label: X6
rows.predicate: \textbf{The decuplet is heavier than the octet} by the colour-magnetic curvature invariant, the colour factor $-8$ times the spin $\half S(S+1)-\tfrac98$, a derived sign and pattern.

rows.label: X7
rows.predicate: \textbf{The proton is stable} as the minimal-wrap residue-$1$ state, with no lighter $B=1$ residue to reach.

rows.label: X8
rows.predicate: \textbf{The neutron is heavier than the proton} because the $d-u$ seed exceeds the charge-squared electromagnetic term ($\sum Q^2=1$ for $p$, $\tfrac23$ for $n$), a derived ordering.

rows.label: X9
rows.predicate: \textbf{$\Sigma$ is heavier than $\Lambda$} by the spin-$1$ versus spin-$0$ light-pair hyperfine, a derived splitting of two states of identical quark content.

rows.label: X10
rows.predicate: \textbf{The isospin splittings obey Coleman--Glashow} exactly at one body, $(n{-}p)+(\Xi^-{-}\Xi^0)=\Sigma^-{-}\Sigma^+$, a derived identity.

rows.label: X11
rows.predicate: \textbf{The heavy baryons follow heavy-quark symmetry}, $M_{\Lambda_b}-M_{\Lambda_c}=M_B-M_D$ by spin decoupling, so the baryon and meson heavy-mass differences are one quantity.

rows.label: X12
rows.predicate: \textbf{The vector mesons equally space}, $2M_{K^{*}}=M_\rho+M_\phi$, the meson residue $1$ ($B=0$) on the same frame and scale as the baryons.

rows.label: X13
rows.predicate: \textbf{The spectrum rests on one scale}, $\sqrt\sigma=\LQCD$, the lone $\Om$-hard residue; every dimensionless mass ratio is a sub-horizon eigenvalue.

rows.label: P1
rows.predicate: Gell-Mann--Okubo exact at leading order; PDG $0.57\%$, the bounded $\chi_3^2$ second order. Falsifier: a violation beyond the second-order insertion.

rows.label: P2
rows.predicate: Decuplet equal spacing exact; PDG $9.2\%$ spread, $\beta\simeq146.8$ MeV, the same second order. Falsifier: a non-equal spacing beyond it.

rows.label: P3
rows.predicate: The hyperfine pattern $g_{\mathrm{spin}}=\half S(S+1)-\tfrac98$, octet $-\tfrac34$, decuplet $+\tfrac34$, separation $\tfrac32A_{\mathrm{light}}$ with $A_{\mathrm{light}}\simeq195$ MeV. Falsifier: a spin splitting outside this pattern.
rows.source: C5\newline \pywit{hadrons}{p35053}{P3}, \leanwit{FrcCore}{p35053}{P3}, \leanwit{FrcMathlib}{p35053}{P3}; rests on B3, C6 \lean{FRC.Hadrons.spin\_pattern, Hadrons.a\_light, Hadrons.spin\_pattern}

rows.label: P4
rows.predicate: Proton effective stability: the proton is the minimal colour-neutral wrap, with no allowed strong or electromagnetic channel toward a smaller residue; the single neutron transition is one flavour flip, the $\beta$ channel \cite{akhtman2026fields}. Falsifier: an observed proton decay or a strong/electromagnetic baryon-number-violating process.

rows.label: P5
rows.predicate: No exotic light multiplets beyond the $\mathbf 8$ and $\mathbf{10}$ at leading wrap order. Falsifier: a confirmed light baryon outside the $\mathbf 8$ and $\mathbf{10}$ at the wrap scale.

rows.label: P6
rows.predicate: Coleman--Glashow exact at one body; PDG $0.79\%$, the residual the two-body electromagnetic term; the orderings $M_n>M_p$ and $M_\Sigma>M_\Lambda$ fixed. Falsifier: a Coleman--Glashow violation beyond the two-body term.

rows.label: P7
rows.predicate: Heavy-quark symmetry $M_{\Lambda_b}-M_{\Lambda_c}=M_B-M_D$ ($2.4\%$) and the $1/m_Q$ hyperfine ratio $(M_{\Sigma_c^{*}}-M_{\Sigma_c})/(M_{\Sigma^{*}}-M_{\Sigma})\simeq m_s/m_c$. Falsifier: a heavy-baryon spectrum off the spin-decoupled, $1/m_Q$-scaled pattern.

rows.label: P8
rows.predicate: Second-order decuplet relation \eqref{eq:thirddiff}, the vanishing third difference; PDG $6$ MeV ($0.36\%$). Falsifier: a third difference beyond the few-MeV third-order scale.

rows.label: P9

Falsifier: a predicted mass off beyond the traced second order.

C1.name: FRC.Hadrons.colour_group
C1.doc: 35:C1, 35:X2 — the colour group built exactly: `36` unit vectors, `648` orthonormal frames (`U(3, 2)`), `216` of determinant one (`SU(3, 2)`), every element unitary (`g†g = I`) with `det g = 1`; the triality centre: the elements commuting with `D1` and `U1` are exactly the three scalars `I, wI, w²I`, and each scalar commutes with the whole group. `su3_centre` of the interactions theme shows the scalars central; here the centre is no larger.

C1.name: FRC.Interactions.su3_centre
C1.doc: 27:C7, 27:X7, 35:C1, 35:X2 — the scalar centre of `SU(3, 2)` over `𝔽₄`: the scalars `x I` with `x x̄ = 1` and `x³ = 1` are the three cube roots of unity `1, w, w²` (`ℤ₃`, colour triality), `0` is not one, and each commutes with `U₁` and `U₂`; that the centre is no larger is 27-fields' ledger check E1 (all `216²` products) and, in the kernel, the hadrons theme's `FRC.Hadrons.colour_group` (the commutant of `D₁` and `U₁` in the group built by frames is the three scalars).

C2.name: FRC.Hadrons.gmo
C2.doc: 35:C2, 35:X4, 35:P1 — Gell-Mann–Okubo as a ring identity: `2N + 2Ξ − 3Λ − Σ = 0` for every `M₀, a, c`; the scale and the breaking parameters cancel.

C3.name: FRC.Hadrons.spacing
C3.doc: 35:C3, 35:X5, 35:P2 — decuplet equal spacing as a ring identity: the two second differences `Δ − 2Σ* + Ξ*` and `Σ* − 2Ξ* + Ω` vanish for every `α, β`.

C4.name: FRC.Hadrons.colour_factor
C4.doc: 35:C4, 35:X6 — the colour factor of the singlet with denominators cleared: `2N C₂(𝟛) = N² − 1` gives `6 C₂ = 8` (`C₂ = 4/3`); `2 Σ_{i<j} T_i·T_j = C₂(𝟙) − 3 C₂(𝟛)` gives `12 Σ T·T = −24` (`−2`); `λ = 2T` gives `Σ λ·λ = −8`, `−8/3` per pair.

C5.name: FRC.Hadrons.spin_pattern
C5.doc: 35:C5, 35:X6, 35:P3 — the spin pattern with denominators cleared: for `S = n/2`, `8 g_spin = 8[½S(S+1) − 9/8] = n(n+2) − 9`: the octet (`n = 1`) `−6/8 = −3/4`, the decuplet (`n = 3`) `6/8 = 3/4`, the separation `12/8 = 3/2`; the eigenvalues of `Σ(λ·λ)(S·S)` on the singlet, `(−8/3) g`: `(−8)(−6) = 48 = 2 · 24` (`+2`) and `(−8)(6) = −48` (`−2`).

C6.name: FRC.Hadrons.adjoint_channel
C6.doc: 35:C14, 35:C6, 35:C23 — the representation content behind the character sums, as Haar moments by the Weyl constant term: `E[χχ̄] = 1` (`𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛̄` has one singlet), `E[χ²] = 0` (`𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛` has none), `E[χ²χ̄²] − E[χχ̄] = 1` (the adjoint `𝟠 = χχ̄ − 1` sits in `𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛̄` once), `E[χ³χ̄] − E[χ²] = 0` (`𝟠` is absent from `𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛`). The single-plaquette coefficients `c₁ = β/(2N²) = β/18` and `c_adj = β²/(2N)² = β²/36` at `N = 3`.

C7.name: FRC.Hadrons.coleman_glashow
C7.doc: 35:C7, 35:X10, 35:P6 — Coleman–Glashow as a one-body identity: counting the `d − u` content, `n − p = δ`, `Ξ⁻ − Ξ⁰ = δ`, `Σ⁻ − Σ⁺ = 2δ`, so `(n − p) + (Ξ⁻ − Ξ⁰) − (Σ⁻ − Σ⁺) = 0` for every one-body unit `δ`.

C8.name: FRC.Hadrons.charge_structure
C8.doc: 35:C8, 35:C13, 35:X8, 35:C21 — the charge structure with `9Q²` integral (`Q_u = 2/3`, `Q_d = −1/3`): one-body `9 Σ Q² = 4 + 4 + 1 = 9` for the proton (`1`) and `4 + 1 + 1 = 6` for the neutron (`2/3`); two-body `9 Σ_{i<j} Q_iQ_j = 4 − 2 − 2 = 0` for the proton and `−2 − 2 + 1 = −3` for the neutron (`−1/3`); both differences `p − n` positive (`+3`, `+3`, that is `+1/3` each): the electromagnetic term makes the proton heavier.

C9.name: FRC.Hadrons.sigma_lambda
C9.doc: 35:C9, 35:X9 — the `Σ`–`Λ` fine structure: the light pair's `S_u·S_d` is `−3/4` at spin `0` and `+1/4` at spin `1` (`4 S·S = 2S(S+1) − 3`: `−3`, `+1`); the strange quark's coupling to the pair, `2 S_s·(S_u + S_d) = S(S+1) − S_ud(S_ud+1) − 3/4` at total spin `½` (`4S(S+1) = 3`): `0` for the spin-`0` pair, `−1` for the spin-`1` pair (`8 S_s·S_pair = 3 − 4S_ud(S_ud+1) − 3`: `0`, `−8`). So `M_Σ − M_Λ = a_ll(1/4 + 3/4) + a_ls(−1 − 0) = a_ll − a_ls`.

C11.name: FRC.Hadrons.third_difference
C11.doc: 35:C11, 35:P8 — the decuplet third difference vanishes identically in the model: `Δ − 3Σ* + 3Ξ* − Ω = 0` for every `M₀, d, A, r`.

C12.name: FRC.Hadrons.hyperfine_links
C12.doc: 35:C12 — the two octet–decuplet hyperfine links, parameter-free: `3(Σ − Λ) = 2[(Δ − N) − (Σ* − Σ)]` and `(Σ* − Σ) − (Ξ* − Ξ) = 0`.

C13.name: FRC.Hadrons.charge_structure
C13.doc: 35:C8, 35:C13, 35:X8, 35:C21 — the charge structure with `9Q²` integral (`Q_u = 2/3`, `Q_d = −1/3`): one-body `9 Σ Q² = 4 + 4 + 1 = 9` for the proton (`1`) and `4 + 1 + 1 = 6` for the neutron (`2/3`); two-body `9 Σ_{i<j} Q_iQ_j = 4 − 2 − 2 = 0` for the proton and `−2 − 2 + 1 = −3` for the neutron (`−1/3`); both differences `p − n` positive (`+3`, `+3`, that is `+1/3` each): the electromagnetic term makes the proton heavier.

C14.name: FRC.Hadrons.adjoint_channel
C14.doc: 35:C14, 35:C6, 35:C23 — the representation content behind the character sums, as Haar moments by the Weyl constant term: `E[χχ̄] = 1` (`𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛̄` has one singlet), `E[χ²] = 0` (`𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛` has none), `E[χ²χ̄²] − E[χχ̄] = 1` (the adjoint `𝟠 = χχ̄ − 1` sits in `𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛̄` once), `E[χ³χ̄] − E[χ²] = 0` (`𝟠` is absent from `𝟛 ⊗ 𝟛`). The single-plaquette coefficients `c₁ = β/(2N²) = β/18` and `c_adj = β²/(2N)² = β²/36` at `N = 3`.

C15.name: FRC.Hadrons.colourless_content
C15.doc: 35:C15, 35:X1, 35:X3, 35:X7, 35:P4 — the colourless content of `Λ•(𝟛)` is `(1, 0, 0, 1)`: the vacuum; no nonzero vector of `𝟛` fixed by the group (a single quark has residue `0`); none of `Λ²(𝟛) ≅ 𝟛̄` (the diquark); `Λ³(𝟛) = det`, fixed by every element (`det g = 1`), the one-dimensional invariant — the baryon at `k = N = 3`, residue `1`. The dimensions `1, 3, 3, 1` sum to `8 = 2³`.

C16.name: FRC.Hadrons.airy_sturm
C16.doc: 35:C16 — the finite confinement operator `H^{(N)} = −u'' + x u` on `N = 200` sites of `[0, 16]`: Sturm's count of the integer tridiagonal `201³ T + 16³ K` at `μ = 201 · 256 · ε` places exactly one eigenvalue in `(2.33, 2.34)`, one in `(4.08, 4.09)`, one in `(5.51, 5.52)` and one in `(6.77, 6.79)`: the finite-stage spectrum sits at the decimals of the Airy zeros to the grid's accuracy (the readout `2.338, 4.088, 5.521, 6.787` is the chart's).

C16.name: FRC.Hadrons.lambda_n_gap
C16.doc: 35:C16, 35:P11, 35:P10 — the Λ–N gap is the strange constituent excess: `M_Λ − M_N = m_s − m_l` for every `l, s, u`, the hyperfine cancelling.

C21.name: FRC.Hadrons.charge_structure
C21.doc: 35:C8, 35:C13, 35:X8, 35:C21 — the charge structure with `9Q²` integral (`Q_u = 2/3`, `Q_d = −1/3`): one-body `9 Σ Q² = 4 + 4 + 1 = 9` for the proton (`1`) and `4 + 1 + 1 = 6` for the neutron (`2/3`); two-body `9 Σ_{i<j} Q_iQ_j = 4 − 2 − 2 = 0` for the proton and `−2 − 2 + 1 = −3` for the neutron (`−1/3`); both differences `p − n` positive (`+3`, `+3`, that is `+1/3` each): the electromagnetic term makes the proton heavier.

X2.name: FRC.Hadrons.colour_group
X2.doc: 35:C1, 35:X2 — the colour group built exactly: `36` unit vectors, `648` orthonormal frames (`U(3, 2)`), `216` of determinant one (`SU(3, 2)`), every element unitary (`g†g = I`) with `det g = 1`; the triality centre: the elements commuting with `D1` and `U1` are exactly the three scalars `I, wI, w²I`, and each scalar commutes with the whole group. `su3_centre` of the interactions theme shows the scalars central; here the centre is no larger.

X2.name: FRC.Interactions.su3_centre
X2.doc: 27:C7, 27:X7, 35:C1, 35:X2 — the scalar centre of `SU(3, 2)` over `𝔽₄`: the scalars `x I` with `x x̄ = 1` and `x³ = 1` are the three cube roots of unity `1, w, w²` (`ℤ₃`, colour triality), `0` is not one, and each commutes with `U₁` and `U₂`; that the centre is no larger is 27-fields' ledger check E1 (all `216²` products) and, in the kernel, the hadrons theme's `FRC.Hadrons.colour_group` (the commutant of `D₁` and `U₁` in the group built by frames is the three scalars).

X6.name: FRC.Hadrons.spin_pattern
X6.doc: 35:C5, 35:X6, 35:P3 — the spin pattern with denominators cleared: for `S = n/2`, `8 g_spin = 8[½S(S+1) − 9/8] = n(n+2) − 9`: the octet (`n = 1`) `−6/8 = −3/4`, the decuplet (`n = 3`) `6/8 = 3/4`, the separation `12/8 = 3/2`; the eigenvalues of `Σ(λ·λ)(S·S)` on the singlet, `(−8/3) g`: `(−8)(−6) = 48 = 2 · 24` (`+2`) and `(−8)(6) = −48` (`−2`).

X6.name: FRC.Hadrons.colour_factor

X9.name: FRC.Hadrons.sigma_lambda
X9.doc: 35:C9, 35:X9 — the `Σ`–`Λ` fine structure: the light pair's `S_u·S_d` is `−3/4` at spin `0` and `+1/4` at spin `1` (`4 S·S = 2S(S+1) − 3`: `−3`, `+1`); the strange quark's coupling to the pair, `2 S_s·(S_u + S_d) = S(S+1) − S_ud(S_ud+1) − 3/4` at total spin `½` (`4S(S+1) = 3`): `0` for the spin-`0` pair, `−1` for the spin-`1` pair (`8 S_s·S_pair = 3 − 4S_ud(S_ud+1) − 3`: `0`, `−8`). So `M_Σ − M_Λ = a_ll(1/4 + 3/4) + a_ls(−1 − 0) = a_ll − a_ls`.
